question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Subtracted
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e'Adjunct'.. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Subtracted"** means to take one number or amount away from another.
 
• The word that is** opposite** in meaning to** "Subtracted" **is: **"Adjunct**"
 
• In the context of mathematics,** "Adjunct"** refers to something added or joined to something else, which is the opposite of subtraction.
 
• Please note that **"Adjunct"** can also mean an assistant or supplementary component in other contexts.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Adjunct'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other options:
 
 
• **"Separated"** means to set or keep apart.(अलग किया हुआ)
 
• **"Recap" **is a brief summary or review of something.(संक्षेप में दोहराना)
 
• **"Annihilatory" **means causing complete destruction or obliteration. (नष्ट करनेवाला)
